items.title: Partisan Takes a Majority Stake in Alex Sheridan's OTM Music, Formally Debuts 'An Expanded Independent Publishing Operation'
items.summary: Partisan Music has officially become a majority partner in Alex Sheridan’s OTM Music, which is set to absorb the investing company’s Left Music team and roster to form “an expanded independent publishing operation.” The involved parties reached out with word of the strategic merger, pointing first to Partisan’s acquiring the OTM stake previously held by [ ]

items.title: Primary Wave Inks Catalog and NIL Partnership Deal With the Estate of 'Addicted to Love' Singer-Songwriter Robert Palmer
items.summary: Primary Wave has partnered with the estate of Robert Palmer under a deal extending to the “Bad Case of Loving You (Doctor, Doctor)” artist’s catalog and all-important name, image, and likeness rights. The Palmer estate and Primary Wave formally announced their tie-up today – albeit without shedding light on the precise ownership and financial details [ ]

items.title: MNRK Acquires 'Complete' Black Label Society Catalog, Eyes 'New Projects That Fuse Traditional Heavy Metal With Contemporary Sounds'
items.summary: MNRK Music Group has officially acquired the “complete” recorded catalog of Zakk Wylde-founded Black Label Society (BLS), including over 300 total tracks from the veteran heavy metal group.
